EN-LIS-F00-Q01.text: Which animal is sleeping? Listen to the sentence, then tap your answer.

EN-LIS-F00-Q02.text: One short word is coming. Find it on the screen and tap it.

EN-LIS-F00-Q03.text: Listen to the sentence, then answer the question. What colour is the cup?

EN-LIS-F00-Q04.text: How many apples are there? Listen carefully, then tap the number.

EN-LIS-F00-Q05.text: Listen to what you're asked to do. What should you close? Tap your answer.

EN-LIS-F00-Q06.text: Listen to the sentence for a clue about the weather. Then tap the picture that shows it.

EN-LIS-F00-Q07.text: Listen to the sentence about Sam. Then answer the question: what does Sam drink?

EN-LIS-F00-Q08.text: Listen closely. Where are the keys? Tap the place you hear.

EN-LIS-T01-Q01.text: You'll hear one word in a moment. Take your time with the choices on the screen, then tap the written word that matches what you heard.

EN-LIS-T01-Q02.text: Here's a careful-listening challenge. A single word is coming. Pick the written word that matches it exactly, sound for sound.

EN-LIS-T01-Q03.text: Time to be a sound detective. Listen to the word, then check each choice on the screen. Which one is exactly what you heard?

EN-LIS-T01-Q04.text: Get ready to listen. When the word plays, compare it with the words on the screen and tap the one you heard.

EN-LIS-T01-Q05.text: These choices are close cousins. Listen to every sound in the word, then tap the one on the screen that matches.

EN-LIS-T01-Q06.text: Ears on. One word is about to play. Notice how it begins and how it ends, then find it among the words on the screen.

EN-LIS-T01-Q07.text: Settle in and listen. A word is on its way. When you've heard it, tap the written word that matches.

EN-LIS-T01-Q08.text: Listen to the whole word, not just the start. Then choose the word on the screen that matches what you heard.

EN-LIS-T01-Q09.text: A word is hiding inside the sound you're about to hear. Catch it with your ears, then tap the word on the screen that matches.

EN-LIS-T01-Q10.text: Ready, set, listen. A word is heading your way. When you hear it, find the matching word on the screen and tap it.

EN-LIS-T02-Q01.text: When the word plays, look at the three pictures and tap the one that shows it.

EN-LIS-T02-Q02.text: One word, three pictures. Listen carefully and work out which picture matches the word you hear.

EN-LIS-T02-Q03.text: In a moment you'll hear a word. Find the picture that goes with it and give it a tap.

EN-LIS-T02-Q04.text: Quick ears needed. Listen to the word, then choose the picture that shows exactly that.

EN-LIS-T02-Q05.text: Listen closely, then look closely. Study each picture and tap the one that matches the word you heard.

EN-LIS-T02-Q06.text: Have a listen. When you know the word, tap the picture that matches it.

EN-LIS-T02-Q07.text: Here's a word to catch. Listen, then pick the picture on the screen that it names.

EN-LIS-T02-Q08.text: First the word, then the pictures. Study them and tap the one that shows what you heard.

EN-LIS-T02-Q09.text: Shh, a word is coming. When you hear it, find its picture and tap it.

EN-LIS-T02-Q10.text: What will the word be? Listen and find out. Then tap the picture that matches what you heard.

EN-LIS-T03-Q01.text: Here comes a sentence. Have a think while you listen. Is it true? Tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T03-Q02.text: Someone is about to tell you something. Listen closely, then decide if it's true and tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T03-Q03.text: Be the judge on this one. Listen to the sentence. If it's true, tap the tick. If it isn't, tap the cross.

EN-LIS-T03-Q04.text: What will the sentence say? Listen and find out. Then tap the tick if it's true, or the cross if it's not.

EN-LIS-T03-Q05.text: A short sentence is on its way. When you've heard it, ask yourself if it's true, then tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T03-Q06.text: Ears ready? Listen to the sentence. Tap the tick if you think it's true, or the cross if you don't.

EN-LIS-T03-Q07.text: Hmm, is it true? Listen to the sentence first, then tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T03-Q08.text: Here's a sentence to think about. Listen all the way to the end, then tap to say whether it's true.

EN-LIS-T03-Q09.text: Time to listen and decide. Is the sentence you hear true? Tap the tick or the cross.

EN-LIS-T03-Q10.text: This one needs careful ears. Do you think the sentence is true? Tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T04-Q01.text: You'll hear a word. Then look at the words on the screen and tap the one that rhymes with it.

EN-LIS-T04-Q02.text: Listen to the word and hold on to how it ends. Which word on the screen rhymes with it?

EN-LIS-T04-Q03.text: Rhyme hunt. Listen to the word, then check the choices on the screen. Which one rhymes?

EN-LIS-T04-Q04.text: Say the word quietly to yourself after you hear it. Then find the word on the screen that rhymes with it.

EN-LIS-T04-Q05.text: After the word plays, try each choice in your head, one at a time. Which one rhymes?

EN-LIS-T04-Q06.text: Here's a word to match by sound. Listen, then find the word on the screen that rhymes with it.

EN-LIS-T04-Q07.text: Take a breath and listen. Which word on the screen rhymes with the word you hear?

EN-LIS-T04-Q08.text: Think like a poet. Listen to the word, then pick the one on the screen that would rhyme with it in a poem.

EN-LIS-T04-Q09.text: Rhyme time. Listen to the word, then find a word on the screen that rhymes with it.

EN-LIS-T04-Q10.text: A word is about to pop out of the speaker. Which word on the screen rhymes with it? Tap it.

EN-LIS-T05-Q01.text: Notice the very first sound of the word you're about to hear. Then tap the letter that makes that sound.

EN-LIS-T05-Q02.text: Focus on the beginning. Which letter makes the first sound of the word you hear?

EN-LIS-T05-Q03.text: How does the word start? Listen closely, then tap the letter for that opening sound.

EN-LIS-T05-Q04.text: A word is coming. What sound does it start with? Tap the matching letter.

EN-LIS-T05-Q05.text: Catch the first sound of the word. Then pick the letter or letters on the screen that make it.

EN-LIS-T05-Q06.text: Some starting sounds are close cousins. Listen to the word and choose the letter that matches how it begins.

EN-LIS-T05-Q07.text: After you hear the word, say it quietly to yourself. Which letter makes its first sound?

EN-LIS-T05-Q08.text: Pay attention to the very first sound, the one your mouth makes first. Then choose the letter that matches it.

EN-LIS-T05-Q09.text: Ready for a sound hunt? Listen to the word and catch its first sound. Then tap the letter that makes it.

EN-LIS-T05-Q10.text: How does this word begin? Listen and find out, then tap the letter for that first sound.

EN-LIS-T06-Q01.text: This time, listen for the end of the word. Which letter makes its final sound?

EN-LIS-T06-Q02.text: Wait for the very last sound in the word. Then tap the letter that makes it.

EN-LIS-T06-Q03.text: Endings can be hard to hear. Listen right to the end of the word and choose the letter for its last sound.

EN-LIS-T06-Q04.text: How does this word finish? Listen, then tap the letter for that ending sound.

EN-LIS-T06-Q05.text: Track the word all the way to its end. Which letters on the screen make that last sound?

EN-LIS-T06-Q06.text: Hold on to the final sound of the word you hear. Pick the letter that matches it.

EN-LIS-T06-Q07.text: When the word plays, notice where your mouth ends up. Tap the letter for that last sound.

EN-LIS-T06-Q08.text: Forget the start this time. Focus on how the word ends, then tap the letter for its final sound.

EN-LIS-T06-Q09.text: Stay with this word right to the end. What sound do you hear last? Tap its letter.

EN-LIS-T06-Q10.text: Follow the word to the very end. Which letter makes the last sound you hear? Tap it.

EN-LIS-T07-Q01.text: Clap along with each beat of the word you hear. How many claps did you make? Tap that number.

EN-LIS-T07-Q02.text: Here's a counting challenge. Clap the beats in the word you hear, then tap the number.

EN-LIS-T07-Q03.text: Listen, then clap the word out slowly. How many claps? Tap the number on the screen.

EN-LIS-T07-Q04.text: Here's a word to clap. Break it into beats as you listen, then tap how many claps it has.

EN-LIS-T07-Q05.text: Each part of the word gets one clap. Clap as you listen, then tap the number of claps.

EN-LIS-T07-Q06.text: Count the beats. Listen to the word, clap it out, and tap the number that matches your claps.

EN-LIS-T07-Q07.text: Take it slowly. Clap once for every beat in the word you hear, then tap your total.

EN-LIS-T07-Q08.text: Listen, clap and count. How many beats are in the word? Tap the number.

EN-LIS-T07-Q09.text: Get your hands ready. Listen to the word and clap along with it. How many claps? Tap the number.

EN-LIS-T07-Q10.text: Time to clap. Listen to the word, clap every beat you hear, and then tap the number of claps.

EN-LIS-T08-Q01.text: You'll hear three words. Two of them go together and one doesn't. Tap the one that doesn't belong.

EN-LIS-T08-Q02.text: Three words are coming. Listen to all of them and work out which one doesn't fit with the others.

EN-LIS-T08-Q03.text: What links these words? Listen to all three, then tap the odd one out.

EN-LIS-T08-Q04.text: Hear all three words before you choose. Which one does not belong with the rest?

EN-LIS-T08-Q05.text: Spot the stranger. Listen to the three words and tap the one that doesn't belong.

EN-LIS-T08-Q06.text: Three words, one odd one out. Listen carefully, then tap the word that doesn't belong.

EN-LIS-T08-Q07.text: This time it's all about rhyme. Listen to the three words. Which one does not rhyme with the others?

EN-LIS-T08-Q08.text: Wait until you've heard all three words. Then decide which one doesn't belong with the other two.

EN-LIS-T08-Q09.text: Three words are lining up to say hello, but one doesn't belong. Listen, then tap the odd one out.

EN-LIS-T08-Q10.text: Which word is the odd one? Listen to all three and tap the one that doesn't belong.

EN-LIS-T09-Q01.text: One word in this sentence is hidden behind a beep. Listen, then tap the word on the screen that fits the gap.

EN-LIS-T09-Q02.text: A word has gone missing from this sentence, and there's a beep instead. Listen, then choose the word that fits.

EN-LIS-T09-Q03.text: Listen to the whole sentence, beep and all. Which word on the screen makes the sentence make sense?

EN-LIS-T09-Q04.text: You'll hear a sentence with a beep where a word should be. Pick the word that fills the gap.

EN-LIS-T09-Q05.text: Something's missing. Listen for the beep in the sentence, then find the choice that belongs there.

EN-LIS-T09-Q06.text: When the beep sounds, think about what should go there. Then choose it on the screen.

EN-LIS-T09-Q07.text: Here's a sentence with a gap. Listen all the way through, then pick the word that fits best.

EN-LIS-T09-Q08.text: There's a beep hiding a word in this sentence. Listen, then choose which word on the screen fills the gap.

EN-LIS-T09-Q09.text: A beep is hiding one word in this sentence. Can you work out which word on the screen fits in its place?

EN-LIS-T09-Q10.text: Ready? A sneaky beep has jumped into this sentence. Listen, then pick a word that fits the gap.

EN-LIS-T10-Q01.text: You'll hear some steps. Listen to the order they come in, then drag the cards so they match.

EN-LIS-T10-Q02.text: Listen for what happens first, next and last. Then drag the cards into that order.

EN-LIS-T10-Q03.text: Three steps are coming. Keep them in your head in order, then drag the cards to match what you heard.

EN-LIS-T10-Q04.text: Pay attention to the order of the steps you hear. Then put the cards in the same order.

EN-LIS-T10-Q05.text: Listen out for order words like first and then. Drag the cards so the steps go in the order you heard.

EN-LIS-T10-Q06.text: Here's a short sequence to remember. Listen, then drag each card into its place, from first to last.

EN-LIS-T10-Q07.text: What comes first? Listen to the three steps, then drag the cards into order.

EN-LIS-T10-Q08.text: Step by step, follow what you hear. Then arrange the cards in the same order.

EN-LIS-T10-Q09.text: Listen to the steps: one, two, three. Then drag the pictures into the order you heard them.

EN-LIS-T10-Q10.text: A little story is coming in three steps. Listen, then put the cards in story order.

EN-LIS-T11-Q01.text: You'll hear three words. Match each word you hear to its picture.

EN-LIS-T11-Q02.text: One by one, the words will play. Link each one to the picture that shows it.

EN-LIS-T11-Q03.text: Three words, three pictures. Listen carefully and match them all.

EN-LIS-T11-Q04.text: Pair each word you hear with the picture that goes with it.

EN-LIS-T11-Q05.text: Here come some words. Listen, then match every word to its picture.

EN-LIS-T11-Q06.text: Can you match them all? Listen to the words and connect each one to its picture.

EN-LIS-T11-Q07.text: Take your time with this one. Listen to the words, then match each to the picture it goes with.

EN-LIS-T11-Q08.text: Catch each word as it plays. Then find the picture for each one and match them up.

EN-LIS-T11-Q09.text: Three words are coming, and each one has a picture partner. Listen, then match every word to its picture.

EN-LIS-T11-Q10.text: Picture matching time. Listen to the words, then match each one to its picture.

EN-LIS-T12-Q01.text: The voice will ask you to find something. There's more than one right answer, so tap all the pictures that fit.

EN-LIS-T12-Q02.text: Treasure hunt time. Listen to the clue, then tap every picture that matches it. There's more than one.

EN-LIS-T12-Q03.text: More than one answer fits this one. Listen to the instruction, then tap all the ones that do.

EN-LIS-T12-Q04.text: What will you be asked to find? Listen, then tap all the pictures that fit. There's more than one.

EN-LIS-T12-Q05.text: Not just one picture this time. Listen to the instruction, then tap every picture that fits.

EN-LIS-T12-Q06.text: Here's a listening job for you. Hear the instruction, then tap all the pictures that match. There's more than one answer.

EN-LIS-T12-Q07.text: Look at every picture after you hear the instruction, and tap all the ones that fit.

EN-LIS-T12-Q08.text: Ready? Listen for the clue. More than one picture fits it, so tap them all.

EN-LIS-T12-Q09.text: Listen to the instruction, then look at each picture. Tap every one that fits. There's more than one answer.

EN-LIS-T12-Q10.text: You'll be asked to find more than one thing. Listen carefully, then tap all the pictures that fit.

EN-LIS-T13-Q01.text: Listen to the instruction. Then do exactly what it asks.

EN-LIS-T13-Q02.text: Stay with the instruction all the way through. Then follow it exactly as you heard it.

EN-LIS-T13-Q03.text: You'll hear an instruction. Look at the pictures and do exactly what it says.

EN-LIS-T13-Q04.text: Here's an instruction for you. Listen, then follow it exactly.

EN-LIS-T13-Q05.text: Listen to every word of this instruction. Then do exactly what it says, no more and no less.

EN-LIS-T13-Q07.text: An instruction is coming. Hold it in your mind, then carry it out exactly.

EN-LIS-T13-Q08.text: Careful ears for this instruction. Do exactly what it tells you, and nothing else.

EN-LIS-T13-Q09.text: Have a good look at all the pictures first. Then listen to the instruction and do just what it asks.

EN-LIS-T13-Q10.text: Listening mission. Hear the instruction, remember it, then do exactly what it says.

EN-LIS-T14-Q01.text: Here's a little story. Listen, then answer the question at the end by tapping the tick or the cross.

EN-LIS-T14-Q02.text: A short story and a question are coming. Listen to both, then tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T14-Q03.text: Story time, quick version. Listen, think about the question, and tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T14-Q04.text: A tiny story is coming, with a question at the end. What do you think? Tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T14-Q05.text: Listen closely to the story. Then think about the question and tap the tick or the cross.

EN-LIS-T14-Q06.text: What happens in this story? Listen, and when you hear the question, tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T14-Q07.text: Here's a story to think about. Listen all the way to the question, then tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T14-Q08.text: What would you do? Listen to the story and the question, then tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T14-Q09.text: Have a careful listen to this one, then a little think. Tap the tick or the cross.

EN-LIS-T14-Q10.text: Here's a question to wonder about. Listen, then tap your answer.

EN-LIS-T15-Q01.text: Clue time. Listen to Leo's story. Why did he take an umbrella? Choose the answer that fits.

EN-LIS-T15-Q02.text: Why did the leaves stand up? Keep that question in mind as you listen, then choose your answer.

EN-LIS-T15-Q03.text: Listen to the story about Kiran. Then think about why he was calm in the morning, and pick your answer.

EN-LIS-T15-Q04.text: Listen closely to Ana's story. Why did she smile? Choose the answer the story points to.

EN-LIS-T15-Q05.text: Nina is in this story. Listen to what she does, then decide why she walked instead of running.

EN-LIS-T15-Q06.text: This story is about Ben. Listen, then think about how the boy felt after Ben asked him, and choose your answer.

EN-LIS-T15-Q07.text: Here's a story about Tia. Listen, then think about why her mum said thank you.

EN-LIS-T15-Q08.text: Listen to Omar's story. What helped him feel calmer? Pick your answer from what you heard.

EN-LIS-T15-Q09.text: Use the clues in this little story to guess what happened next. Listen closely.

EN-LIS-T15-Q10.text: Listen to Maya's story. Why do you think she washed first? Pick the answer that makes sense.
